q: What should an eval set be built from first?
options: Real outputs read by people, with failures turned into cases
explain: Start from errors you actually see.

q: A new model scores 3 points higher overall. What should you check before switching?
options: Per-slice results, since one slice may have regressed sharply

q: Which layer of evaluation should run on every commit?
explain: Cheap checks run often; expensive ones run less.
